# PRD-OPS-03

**Is there a runbook, and has an operational readiness review of this version passed?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [Production entry lens](production.md) 0.1.1 |
| Area | OPS: Run |
| Default severity | major |
| Decided by | A tool, by its rule |
| Reads | `operations.runbook`, `evidence.type`, `evidence.outcome` |

## Why it matters

Operational readiness reviews turn the causes of past incidents into questions asked before launch; architecture reads their outcome rather than repeating them.

## Rule

operations.runbook is set; evidence has an operational-readiness entry for this version with outcome passed or passed-with-conditions.

## Sources

- AWS, Operational Readiness Reviews (2022) (`orr`)
- Google, Site Reliability Engineering, chapter 32, The Evolving SRE Engagement Model (the Production Readiness Review) (`sre-prr`)
